name: Dimemebfe
summary: Related in structure to 5-MeO-DMT, yet much less potent. Described as feeling somewhat similar to psilocybin mushrooms, with some additional empathogenic effects.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Dimemebfe acts as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2 family of serotonin receptors. It is several times less potent as a serotonin receptor agonist than 5-MeO-DMT and with relatively more activity at the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor, but still shows strongest actions at the 5-HT2 family of receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The drug has been encountered as a novel designer drug.
